Rivers and surface waters sit at the center of this picture: they are the source of most urban water supply, the receiving body for treated and untreated discharges, and the primary pathway through which flooding, drought, and pollution events reach communities.

Water risk is intensifying. Climate volatility is reshaping flow regimes, intensifying storms, and stressing watersheds. Aging pipes leak, overflow, and fail. Pollution moves through river systems faster than monitoring programs can track it. Yet the data needed to anticipate these risks remains scattered across SCADA systems, sampling reports, sensor feeds, and regulatory filings - rarely brought together into a coherent operational view.

AquaGrid changes that. It provides continuous, system-level visibility into the health and behavior of water networks and the rivers they depend on, giving operators early awareness of flooding risk, infrastructure deterioration, pollution events, and emerging public-health signals before they escalate.

To date, the Fluid Analytics platform has delivered continuous risk visibility across water systems carrying more than 820 million gallons (3.1 billion liters) of daily flows, supporting early detection of pollution events, floods, and infrastructure failures.

Fluid Analytics partners with industrial operators, cities, and engineering firms worldwide to move water risk management from reactive to predictive, watershed-to-tap intelligence.

C:Pesa is a UK based Company that is implementing an end-to-end digital solution for the production of enhanced and verifiable digital Energy Attribute Certificates [EACs] called the “C:Pesa DIGIREC.  

C:Pesa’s mission is to revolutionize the market for Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs), promoting a faster and fairer transition to net-zero, carbon free electricity. EACs are generated to reflect carbon-free electricity produced through solar, wind, geothermal, and hydro sources, and are used by utilities, investment funds, and corporates to certify their use of renewable electricity to achieve global sustainability and ESG goals. Our innovative, patent-pending approach digitizes the end-to-end process, enabling us to provide EACs that are transparent, verifiable, and tradable. This allows us to tap into global low carbon power generation sources that have historically been too small or not been considered trustworthy to access environmental value markets. With rapidly growing clean electricity needs, especially with the expansion of data centres to support generative AI, the demand for EACs is likely to boom over the next decade, and C:Pesa is uniquely placed to confirm net zero, carbon free electricity using the C:Pesa DIGIREC technology solution.

The C:Pesa DIGIREC technology solution provides digital evidence for independent third party verification of low carbon power generation using the I-TRACK Standard Foundation’s taxonomy (https://www.trackingstandard.org/product-code/electricity/). Using this taxonomy to issue a digital C:Pesa DIGIREC, the platform automatically embeds an International Renewable Energy Certificate for Electricity relating to the clean energy generated along with additional data collected at the source of clean energy generation wrapped into a digital certificate.
